title: GTA Online
headline: GTA Online
subtitle: Plan the Perfect Getaway During the Summer Heist Event
content:
Bask in two weeks of highly profitable criminal activity in GTA Online, as summer crowds flock to Southern San Andreas and Cayo Perico.

Capitalize on doubled GTA$ payouts for your first weekly completion of both The Fleeca Heist and The Pacific Standard Heist — active for the first week of the Summer Heist Event (July 30–August 5).

On August 6, the Panther Statue returns to El Rubio’s vault in The Cayo Perico Heist. There’s also a wide range of free login gifts, bonuses, and more.
